    • uploadQuestionsJson

      @PostMapping("/upload-json") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> uploadQuestionsJson(@RequestPart("file") org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile file)
      Receives a JSON file containing a list of questions from the frontend and saves all questions.

      The file is read in-memory and deserialized to a list of Question objects. No file is stored on the server; questions are directly persisted using #saveAll(List).

      Parameters:
      file - JSON file uploaded from frontend, containing a list of questions
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with saved questions on success, or error message on failure
